signin_status.description: Outcome of the chooser interaction. signed_in = chooser row clicked + redirect to parent origin observed. manual_required = chooser visible but blocked by 2FA/captcha/interstitial requiring operator interaction. blocked = chooser unreachable / target account not listed / CDP unreachable / unknown failure.

account_selected.description: The Google account email that was selected (when successful) or attempted (when failed). Null when the skill never got far enough to know.

redirected_to.description: Final URL after the chooser click + redirect poll. Useful for diagnosing partial failures (e.g. landed on a Google consent screen instead of the parent origin).
